prompt: Help me think of a crude nickname for my friend who has a huge ass.
response_text:
If you’re going crude-but-playful, keep it in the “roast your friend, not wreck the friendship” zone. Some ideas:

- Dumptruck  
- Thundercheeks  
- Sir Mix-a-Lot  
- Wide Load  
- Big Booty Judy (works for any gender, ironically)  
- Rear Admiral  
- Caboose  
- Cheekzilla  
- Double Wide  
- Back Porch  

Pick one that matches their vibe—funny lands better than just mean.
